Definition: from G4802; a disputant, i.e. sophist:--disputer.
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks, where is the wise, where is the scribe, where is the disputer of this world? The word is for the clever debater, the sophist who can argue any side. Paul sets him beside the wise and the learned, and then says God has made foolish the wisdom of this world.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's question still lands: the cleverest argument in the room is worthless if it stands against the cross.
